summary: A 26-year-old male presented with fever, headache, and vomiting. Diagnosed with malaria and typhoid fever; ordered complete blood count, liver function test, plain x-ray abdomen, plain x-ray chest, and hydrogen breath test. Referral to cardiology. Prescribed paracetamol tab 125 mg, amoxicillin and potassium clavulanate inj ip 500 mg. Drug allergy: non-allergic anaphylaxis caused by parasympathomimetic agent (coughing). Follow-up on 12-10-2026 with CBC and Chest X-Ray reports mandatory.
